audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagree with the prose beside them. Level 1 was Skill while early opens 'Level 1 belongs to Maokai'; Level 2 was Jax while whys[1] says the early trade stays even; Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were Skill while whys[3] says you own every extended trade and whys[4] calls 6 the prime all-in window; first item was Jax while whys[5] hedges; 2+ items was Jax while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say full-tank Maokai declines the duel and out-scales.
audit.why: This chart was boilerplate, not a reading of the lane. The 2+ items row in particular tells the player to keep side-laning into a matchup the page says is over.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 = Maokai, 1 = Skill, 3 = Jax, 4 = Jax, 5 = Skill, 6 = Maokai, matching the packet chart and every why, with ratings moved to match. One atomic group across both layers; row 2 already agreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no numbers at all.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14s at rank 1 and it is his ONLY dash — the page repeatedly says 'make him burn it first' without ever saying how long that buys you. Bramble Smash is 7s, Sapling Toss 18s, Nature's Grasp 130s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: All four numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns with the 14s tied to the sit-on-him instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] said 'his lock-on root, dodge it' and dosFull[1] is titled 'Dodge his W root'. Both are wrong instructions.
audit.why: Twisted Advance contorts Maokai into moving roots that dash to the TARGET and root on arrival — he is untargetable in transit and it locks on. There is nothing to sidestep once it is cast; the only answer is range (525) and tenacity. Separately, Counter Strike dodges attacks only: Bramble Smash, the sapling and the root all land through it. The content layer already says this correctly; the full layer contradicted it.
audit.corrected: report[5], dosFull[1].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d rewritten to the lock-on and attacks-only facts.
sources: enemyKit W text and flags untargetable/hardCC, range 525

audit.why: Sap Magic heals him on attack, so report[8]'s early Executioner's Calling is correct here.
52.26% over 486 games; EVEN at 6/10 is defensible.

edits.after: - Twisted Advance: 14s at rank 1 — his only dash and his only escape; once it is gone, sit on him. - Bramble Smash: 7s knockback. - Sapling Toss: 18s. - Nature's Grasp: 130s at rank 1.

edits.after: Counter Strike dodges his autos only — Bramble Smash, the sapling and the W root all land through it.

edits.before: Hold E until Maokai commits, Counter-Strike the engage, Q onto him with W loaded, and out-stat the rest.

edits.before: Maokai wastes Twisted Advance (Root) — commit the full pattern immediately.
